nodes.title: Lip-sync workflow - read first
widgets_values:
# Lip-sync to your own audio  (ref2va)

## Usage

- Upload your Reference Image in the **Load Image** node
- Upload your Audio in the **Load Audio** node
- Write your prompt to describe the video
- Set width and height for the video
- Set the duration of the video

## Prompt

Your photo is `<Picture 1>` - an *identity reference* carried through the clip,
not an exact opening frame. The video will look like your subject; it will not necessarily start on your image.

**The prompt must use the tags.** References are addressed positionally as
`<Picture 1>`, `<Audio 1>`.

**NOTE:** The video may NOT be longer than the Audio or it gets out of Sync!

## The 15 second wall

362 frames / 15.08s is H3's trained maximum, so you cannot sync a longer audio in one
pass. Work one segment at a time:

- **duration** is the length of the video.
- **start audio at sec** picks at *which* second the audio starts. It accepts negatives to count from the end.


To build a longer video, render several segments with sequential `start audio at sec`
values and concatenate them afterwards.

## Presets

| # | canvas | duration | tokens | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **0** | manual | manual | - | set width and height manually |
| **1** | 768 x 768 | 5s (124 fr) | 21.3k | safest - square |
| **2** | 1344 x 768 | 5s (124 fr) | 37.3k | max quality wide, 5s |
| **3** | 864 x 480 | 10s (243 fr) | 29.2k | DEFAULT - 10s at 480p |
| **4** | 960 x 544 | 10s (243 fr) | 36.7k | 10s, higher res |
| **5** | 736 x 416 | 15s (362 fr) | 32.0k | safest 15s |
| **6** | 864 x 480 | 15s (362 fr) | 43.3k | max duration - at the OOM edge |

### Preset 0 - manual

Set PRESET to `0` and set width and height manually; they are ignored otherwise.

Seconds snap **UP** to the next legal length. Ask for 12.0s and you get 12.25s (294 frames).
**8.000s (192 frames) is the only exactly-round length** in the usable range.

| frames | secs | frames | secs | frames | secs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 124 | 5.167 | 209 | 8.708 | 294 | 12.250 |
| 141 | 5.875 | 226 | 9.417 | 311 | 12.958 |
| 158 | 6.583 | 243 | 10.125 | 328 | 13.667 |
| 175 | 7.292 | 260 | 10.833 | 345 | 14.375 |
| **192** | **8.000** | 277 | 11.542 | 362 | 15.083 |

## Handle Out of Memory Errors

To avoid out of memory erros:
- Decrease the Resolution (with and height).
- Set the **memory_mode** to _**Lower VRAM (slower)**_  
- Additionally you can decrease the **chunks**.  

(H3 normally creates several very large temporary tensors while generating a video. Larger chunks can be faster but use more temporary memory. Smaller chunks can substantially reduce peak VRAM use.)

nodes.title: Scheduler  -  steps 14. Raise to 20 for finals.
Mux  -  audio comes from YOUR song, not the model
Load CLIP  -  shared with the i2v workflow
Load VAE (audio)  -  encodes your song into the reference
Load Diffusion Model  -  ref2va (NOT fl2va). int8, native on sm_86.
Trim  -  start_index picks WHICH seconds; duration is preset-driven
Sigma Shift  (12 / 3 = model default, no-op as set)
Sage Attention: ON  -  3.0x on attention (measured, this GPU)
